about_the_game:
Due to the volcanic eruption, the climate has become abnormal. Floodwaters are about to inundate our homes. Commander, please lead the people to quickly build an ark and save them!

Total Game Duration Is Approximately 15 Minutes

This game is a simple building game where you just need to click the mouse and consume resources to advance the shipbuilding process in order to achieve victory!

Purchasing this game will grant you approximately 15 minutes of simple shipbuilding experience, with multiple playthrough content (note that the multiple playthrough content has not been rigorously tested, so the gaming experience cannot be guaranteed), and you'll also unlock 2 fun Steam achievements!

Developer's Note

This game idea came to me one afternoon, and I spent quite a bit of time designing and coding it. Although the game may not be perfect, and it has many flaws and lacks sufficient polishing time, it is still a complete game.
